title: KingSong S16 Pro: Conquer Any Terrain

beats.line: Tired of rides that can't handle real trails?
Weak motors and fragile tires limit your adventure. You need more capability.

Command 3000W power. Climb 48-degree grades. Its rugged 16-inch all-terrain tire grips any surface. Experience stable rides with 88 mm of X-Type suspension. A 1480 Wh battery gives up to 130 km range. Built for the ride to everywhere.
Ready to push your limits? Find your KingSong S16 Pro at Radboards.in.
